spans.note: The ADR demonstrates strong tool/action safety practices. It implements a conservative fallback that keeps proposals rather than silently dropping them when the resolver is unavailable, preventing legitimate changes from being lost due to transient errors. The two-layer filtering system validates tool calls before they reach the user, and the deferred confirmation workflow ensures user review before execution.
